visualCharacteristics: Two equal columns: Ingredients (H2, H3 group labels, one ingredient per line, links) and Directions (H2, video promo, large numbered steps, H3, continued numbering); stacks on mobile

cells: Ingredients: H2, H3 sub-groups, bulleted lists of ingredients, links
Directions: H2, optional image + link promo paragraph, numbered lists of steps, H3 sub-groups
contentPattern.structure: Both cells are plain default-style content. A numbered list that continues an earlier one keeps its start number (e.g. starts at 13)

usage.description: Ingredients and directions side by side on recipe pages.

reuseGuidance: Use once per recipe page. Put all ingredients in the first cell and all directions in the second; use H3s for sub-recipes and continue step numbering on later numbered lists.
